evidence_items.explanation: This is material evidence that agents took over actual work, rather than merely existing as product labels. Internal redeployment at one AI company does not independently establish broad white-collar replacement.

receipt.public_excerpt: no extension do we find clear impacts on exposed jobs.

evidence_items.explanation: The study reports no clear unemployment effect in its specified tests. That limited finding neither proves permanent impossibility nor rules out substitution at particular employers.

Klarna's workload-equivalence claim is counterevidence to an unrestricted claim that AI cannot replace any white-collar work. It does not document 700 actual firings or establish the broader capability and scale at issue.

unresolved_gaps: No independently verified demonstration in the reviewed records establishes the specified breadth of complete-role replacement.
Employer workload-equivalence, redeployment and reduced hiring do not directly measure mass dismissals.
No finite employment dataset can establish the permanent impossibility asserted by 'never'.
